note: Source indexes kept inside a project and read in place by scripts/build_registry.py. Each registration names the file, maps its fields and status values onto registry fields, says what the sources were collected for, and holds their relations to Kit pages. Register and relate through praxis_register_index and praxis_curate.

indexes.title: Jev 专章研究登记
indexes.purpose: Jev 专章（System One 决策模型 2026-10-23 快照）五条探索线的来源：A Jev 本身、B 生态、C 微调与部署、D 评测、E 企业与数据库。用于专章逐条事实的核对与引用；评测、部署与企业用法几条线可供之后同类模型或 System One 调研复用。
indexes.limits: 多数网页经摘要式抓取读取，read_scope 写明读到哪里；状态是探索代理的判断，主会话亲自核对过的主张见 jev/research/review.json。不覆盖快照日期之后的变化。
indexes.revisit_when: TypeSafe 发布新版本、定价或评测更新，或要复用其中的数字与结论时，回原页按定位重读。
